title: Holographic foil and brushed-metal sheen
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas extracts micro-relief normals from a live HTML membership card to sweep holographic prism, brushed titanium and gold-leaf sheen across borders and text. Tilt the card in 3D while clicking tier badges, editing the member name and triggering pass actions.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas extract micro-relief normals directly from texElementSubImage2D() luminance gradients to sweep holographic prism, brushed titanium and gold-leaf sheen across embossed borders and typography of a live tilted HTML membership card?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with Sobel micro-relief shading across three optical presets, perspective uMvp synced via updateElementGeometry() and geometryUnit(), 5-argument drawElementImage() 2D foil fallback and plain-HTML context-loss recovery.
